extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of Renaissance satirical literature (general literary readers, scholars of Rabelais)
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and presents a passage from Rabelais (Gargantua and Pantagruel) — a Renaissance satirical prose narrative notable for grotesque exaggeration, mock-learned pastiche, and scatological and bodily humor. The page is a primary-text excerpt rather than a guideline or instruction set.
